phases.name: Foundation Enhancement
phases.description:
Build the core infrastructure that EVERY other component depends on.
All orchestrators log to audit, enforce governance, persist state.
Without this foundation, nothing else can reliably operate.

phases.name: Phase 1.5 - STS (Semantic Test Suite)
phases.description:
Build comprehensive test infrastructure that all orchestrators depend on:

1. Semantic test corpus (100 golden scenarios)
2. Test generation frameworks
3. Evidence validation
4. Integration test harness

phases.name: Orchestration Core (CORE WORKFLOW)
phases.description:
Establishes THE DEFAULT WORKING MECHANISM at the core of CORTEX operations.
MasterOrchestrator is IN CHARGE: evaluates requests, creates tasks, executes.
This is the central controller that all user requests flow through.

phases.name: Feature Orchestrators
phases.description:
Build specialized orchestrators that leverage the core workflow.
Each orchestrator reuses: Audit, Governance, State, Lifecycle, Evidence.
Snowball effect: implementation becomes easier with solid foundation.

phases.name: Intelligence Layer
phases.description:
AI-native features that enhance orchestration with intelligence.
Leverages all previous components: audit history, execution patterns,
governance rules, and orchestrator behaviors.

phases.name: Orchestrator Integration & Audit Validation Suite
phases.description:
Comprehensive end-to-end testing framework validating all orchestrators work
together correctly. Tests focus on:

1. Cross-component integration scenarios (Phase 1→4 orchestrators)
2. Audit trail completeness and traceability
3. Evidence bundle generation and validation
4. State management under concurrent operations
5. Governance enforcement across all components
6. Failure recovery and rollback mechanisms
7. Performance and load scenarios

This phase proves system correctness by validating audit logs contain
complete provenance for all operations.

phases.name: CORTEX Cleanup & Decommission
phases.description:
Remove all temporary scaffolding, planning artifacts, and embedded phase-gating logic.
Post-CORTEX-6.0 decommissioning of construction infrastructure.
Permanent CORTEX system operates with zero references to planning phases.

phases.name: Phase 10 - CORTEX LENS & Onboarding (Intelligent Discovery)
phases.description:
Build universal code analysis and knowledge discovery system that:

1. CORTEX LENS: Reverse-engineer codebase via AST, crawlers, git history
2. Onboarding: Guide teams through intelligent project discovery
3. Knowledge Store: Capture company and domain patterns for reuse
4. MCP Tools: Expose analyzers so Planning/other orchestrators access findings
